newsitem.title: POLAND: TWO POLISH DRUG FIRMS' SALE IN Q4 - MINISTER.
newsitem.headline: TWO POLISH DRUG FIRMS' SALE IN Q4 - MINISTER.

text.p: Poland's treasury ministry is likely to complete the privatisation of two pharmaceutical firms Polfa Krakow SA and Polfa Rzeszow SA in October or November, a deputy treasury minister said on Monday.

"These privatisations require a decision by the cabinet and we will soon submit to it the two projects...we plan to finish the privatisation process in October or November," Piotr Czyzewski told reporters at a privatisation seminar.
Last month, the ministry said it had received more than a dozen bids for stakes in the firms.
The ministry invited bids for at least 10 percent stakes in the firms in January.
It will earmark 15 percent of the shares in each company for employees and five for a planned fund to meet claims for property confiscated under communist rule.
